answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must stake collateral via cryptographic attestation chains verifying operational history, alongside zero-knowledge proofs confirming unique task execution without leaking proprietary models. Staking contracts enforce superlinear staking penalties: creating each clone requires exponential capital exhaustion, making a marble monument or an economic voyage of fake identities mathematically ruinous. Like burning yarrow for defense, fees skyrocket per swarm node.
